Voyager

Make every AI chat yours.

Folders, a timeline, export and formula copy on Gemini, AI Studio, ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Kimi,
each one a plugin. Yours can be one too: a few lines of JSON, no code.

Documentation · Install · Write a plugin · Discord

简体中文 • 繁體中文 • 日本語 • Français • Español • Português • Русский • العربية • 한국어

## How it works Voyager keeps three things apart. - **Sites.** One small file per site says where things are on its page: the sidebar, a message, the composer. - **Primitives.** Abilities Voyager ships once and runs anywhere: a timeline, folders, formula copy, diagrams, export. - **Plugins.** Plain JSON that points primitives and CSS at those places. Nothing in a plugin runs as code, and every change it makes comes off when you turn it off. So a site that redesigns its page needs one file fixed, and on ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Kimi that fix arrives from the plugin catalog without an extension update. A new site is one more file. And a plugin written once runs on every site it names. This is the core of a plugin that blurs the sidebar before you take a screenshot, on four sites: ```json { "matches": [ "https://gemini.google.com/*", "https://chatgpt.com/*", "https://claude.ai/*", "https://chat.deepseek.com/*" ], "contributes": { "styles": [{ "css": ".gv-shot-blur { filter: blur(6px) }" }], "domOps": [ { "op": "addClass", "className": "gv-shot-blur", "target": { "kind": "semantic", "key": "sidebar" } } ] } } ``` `sidebar` is a name, not a selector. Each site's file says what it means there. Voyager's own features are built the same way. The timeline, formula copy, quote reply, reading width and nearly everything else ship as official plugins on top of the same primitives. Folders on Gemini and AI Studio are the last piece still running as built-in code, and they are moving over too. ## What you get ● works once installed · ○ one switch in the popup | Feature | Gemini | AI Studio | ChatGPT | Claude | DeepSeek | Kimi | | -------------------------------------------------------------- | :----: | :-------: | :-----: | :----: | :------: | :--: | | [Folders](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/folders) | ● | ● | ● | ○ | ○ | ○ | | [Timeline](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/timeline) | ● | | ○ | ○ | ○ | | | [Export](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/export) | ● | | ○ | | | ○ | | [Formula copy](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/formula-copy) | ● | ● | ○ | ○ | ○ | | | [Quote reply](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/quote-reply) | ● | | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | | [Diagrams](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/mermaid) | ● | | ○ | | | | | Reading width and typography | ○ | | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | | Vim keys in the input box | ○ | | ○ | ○ | ○ | | | [Send key](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/send-behavior) | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | | Draft auto-save | ○ | | | ○ | ○ | ○ | | [Batch delete](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/batch-delete) | ● | ● | | | | | | Visual effects (snow, rain, sakura) | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | ○ | On every site, and on any other site you add, `localhost` included: - **[Prompt library](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/prompts)**: one library that follows you, here inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/deepseek-harness). - **[Cloud sync](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/cloud-sync)**: folders and prompts through Google Drive, or iCloud on Safari. Gemini also gets [Deep Research export](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/deep-research), [watermark-free images](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/nanobanana), [forks](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/fork), [context sync](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/context-sync), a [default model](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/default-model) and a [Markdown fix](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/markdown-fix). Voyager checks the reply and shows what it changes before you import it. - **Hand it to a coding agent.** Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor the skill at `https://voyager.nagi.fun/skills/write-voyager-plugin/SKILL.md`. - **Write it by hand.** `npx create-voyager-plugin@latest init my-plugin --site claude`, then `check` runs the same checks as the import. A plugin cannot run scripts, load anything from the network or read what your messages say. readmeHtml:
Voyager

Make every AI chat yours.

Folders, a timeline, export and formula copy on Gemini, AI Studio, ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Kimi,
each one a plugin. Yours can be one too: a few lines of JSON, no code.

Documentation · Install · Write a plugin · Discord

简体中文 • 繁體中文 • 日本語 • Français • Español • Português • Русский • العربية • 한국어

How it works

Voyager keeps three things apart.

  • Sites. One small file per site says where things are on its page: the sidebar, a message, the composer.
  • Primitives. Abilities Voyager ships once and runs anywhere: a timeline, folders, formula copy, diagrams, export.
  • Plugins. Plain JSON that points primitives and CSS at those places. Nothing in a plugin runs as code, and every change it makes comes off when you turn it off.

So a site that redesigns its page needs one file fixed, and on ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Kimi that fix arrives from the plugin catalog without an extension update. A new site is one more file. And a plugin written once runs on every site it names.

This is the core of a plugin that blurs the sidebar before you take a screenshot, on four sites:

{
  "matches": [
    "https://gemini.google.com/*",
    "https://chatgpt.com/*",
    "https://claude.ai/*",
    "https://chat.deepseek.com/*"
  ],
  "contributes": {
    "styles": [{ "css": ".gv-shot-blur { filter: blur(6px) }" }],
    "domOps": [
      {
        "op": "addClass",
        "className": "gv-shot-blur",
        "target": { "kind": "semantic", "key": "sidebar" }
      }
    ]
  }
}

sidebar is a name, not a selector. Each site's file says what it means there.

Voyager's own features are built the same way. The timeline, formula copy, quote reply, reading width and nearly everything else ship as official plugins on top of the same primitives. Folders on Gemini and AI Studio are the last piece still running as built-in code, and they are moving over too.

What you get

● works once installed · ○ one switch in the popup

Feature Gemini AI Studio ChatGPT Claude DeepSeek Kimi
Folders ● ● ● ○ ○ ○
Timeline ● ○ ○ ○
Export ● ○ ○
Formula copy ● ● ○ ○ ○
Quote reply ● ○ ○ ○ ○
Diagrams ● ○
Reading width and typography ○ ○ ○ ○ ○
Vim keys in the input box ○ ○ ○ ○
Send key ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○
Draft auto-save ○ ○ ○ ○
Batch delete ● ●
Visual effects (snow, rain, sakura) ○ ○ ○ ○ ○ ○

On every site, and on any other site you add, localhost included:

  • Prompt library: one library that follows you, here inside DeepSeek Harness.
  • Cloud sync: folders and prompts through Google Drive, or iCloud on Safari.

Gemini also gets Deep Research export, watermark-free images, forks, context sync, a default model and a Markdown fix. The full table, with every plugin, is on the plugins page.

During the February 18 Gemini incident, when some users could no longer open their past chats, Voyager users still had them in their folders.

Make it yours

A plugin you write lives only in your browser and needs no pull request.

  • Describe it. In the popup's Local plugins card, choose Describe a change, write one sentence, and carry the prompt to any AI you like. Voyager checks the reply and shows what it changes before you import it.
  • Hand it to a coding agent. Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor the skill at https://voyager.nagi.fun/skills/write-voyager-plugin/SKILL.md.
  • Write it by hand. npx create-voyager-plugin@latest init my-plugin --site claude, then check runs the same checks as the import.

A plugin cannot run scripts, load anything from the network or read what your messages say. What a plugin can do

Install

Note

On Gemini for Enterprise, only the prompt library runs.

        

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

For manual installation or development builds, please refer to the Installation Guide.

Recommended tool: Typeless

I highly recommend Typeless (typeless.com), an AI voice-to-text tool that I used extensively during the development of Voyager. Integrating it into my daily workflow has saved me a tremendous amount of time and significantly boosted my productivity.

🎁 Join via my referral link (Code: gemini-voyager) to get $5 free credits. This also gives me credits to keep maintaining this project—a free way to support my work! ❤️

Community



Follow for Updates
Get the latest updates.

Join the Community
Chat with other users, share prompts, and get help.

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Whether you want to report bugs, suggest features, improve documentation, or submit code:

  • Issues: Reproducible bugs only — use the bug report template
  • Discussions: Feature requests, ideas, and questions — not Issues
  • Pull Requests: Check out CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines
Development Setup 
# Install dependencies (the scripts run on Bun; CI uses Bun 1.3.12)
bun i

# Development mode (with auto-reload)
bun run dev:chrome   # Chrome & Chromium browsers
bun run dev:firefox  # Firefox
bun run dev:safari   # Safari (requires macOS)

# Production builds
bun run build:chrome   # Chrome
bun run build:edge     # Edge package (separate)
bun run build:firefox  # Firefox
bun run build:safari   # Safari
bun run build:all      # Chrome + Firefox + Safari

Safari Development: Run bun run build:safari, then open the tracked Xcode project under Voyager/.

Thank you for helping make Voyager better! ❤️

Thanks

Special thanks to all contributors for their contributions to Voyager ❤️

Credits

Voyager is a small side project. I'd rather spend time building things that help people than building migration paths designed to pull users away from other extensions.

  • ChatGPT Conversation Timeline - The original timeline navigation extension for ChatGPT that inspired this project.

  • gemini-watermark-remover / GeminiWatermarkTool - Image Refinement is adapted from these projects. Third-party MIT notices are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

  • Gemini Helper - The default-model locking logic includes interaction ideas adapted from Gemini Helper, credited in its source.

  • cordis - The plugin runtime's side-effect ledger (PluginScope) borrows its effect/disposal lifecycle design from cordis's fiber model.

Ecosystem

Projects inspired by Voyager:

If your project is inspired by Voyager, forked from it, or built on top of it, share it in Discussions and we'll add it here.

  • DeepSeek Voyager - A fork of Voyager adapted for DeepSeek, bringing timeline navigation and chat management to DeepSeek users!

  • claude-nexus - A Claude.ai enhancement extension inspired by Voyager, featuring timeline navigation, folder management, prompt library and more, with full prompt import/export compatibility with Voyager!

  • Better_Doubao - An advanced browser extension supercharging Doubao with enhanced navigation, organization, and productivity features.

  • DeepSeek Enhancer - A Voyager-inspired enhancement extension for the DeepSeek web app, offering multi-level folders, chat export, formula copy, data backup, and more.

License

Voyager is licensed under GPL-3.0. Third-party MIT notices for Image Refinement-related code and assets are retained in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Gemini is a trademark of Google LLC. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic, PBC. ChatGPT is a trademark of OpenAI, Inc. Kimi is a trademark of Moonshot AI. Voyager is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of these companies.

## ✨ What's New

| Feature | Description | By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Kimi support** _(off by default)_ | Folders, Conversation export, Comfortable Reading Width, Reading Typography, Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send, Draft auto-save, Draft counter, Quote replies and Site check now run on Kimi; turn on the ones you want under Plugins. (closes #1038) | — |
| **Folders stay with their own account** | With account isolation on, folders, Drive sync and Folder as Project's instructions follow the Google account you're on; an unreadable account is reported instead of loading forever. | — |
| **Gemini: new chat in a folder without a reload** | With Folder as Project on, **New chat in this folder** opens a new chat right away with that folder picked. | — |
| **Site check** _(off by default)_ | See how many of the page elements Voyager relies on were found, and pick the part that looks broken; the report has no chat content and is ready for an issue. | — |
| **Claude and DeepSeek export** _(off by default)_ | Turn on **Conversation export** under Plugins to save a whole conversation to a file, read from start to finish. | — |
| **Voyager on phones** | On

releases.name: Voyager v2.1.0
releases.body:
## ✨ What's New

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **ChatGPT Local Bridge** _(off by default)_ | Lets programs on your computer bridge to ChatGPT on the web, with primitives to open a chat, send a prompt with files, wait for and read the reply, and manage project files. Reference usage: [Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli), for the terminal and coding agents. |
| **ChatGPT Pro usage this week** _(off by default)_ | A small ring next to the model picker shows how much GPT-6 Pro you've used this week; hover it for the count. The limit follows your plan, Pro Lite or Pro. In Chrome and Edge. |

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

| Fix | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **Gemini hidden archived chats** | The sidebar keeps loading older chats even when a whole newly loaded page is filed in folders. _(closes #1040)_ |
| **Gemini with several accounts** | An email address in a reply is no longer taken for the signed-in account, so folders no longer load under the wrong one. |
| **ChatGPT reply notifications** | Clicking Work mode's project or files button no longer silences the notification. |
| **Export** | A reply with a table no longer exports as only the table, losing the head

aiSummary.oneLiner: A unified companion app managing conversations across multiple AI chatbot platforms.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Voyager is a comprehensive client application that organizes interactions with various AI chatbots like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT into a single unified workspace. It provides a robust interface to organize chat threads into a navigable folder hierarchy, ensuring historical conversations remain accessible and neatly categorized. The app features a prompt vault to store and reuse frequently used instructions efficiently. Furthermore, it supports custom folder colors and drag-and-drop management to streamline complex, multi-model AI workflows securely.
keyFeatures: Folder organization: Structures AI conversations into a two-level hierarchy with drag-and-drop capability.
Multi-platform support: Integrates seamlessly with popular services like Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT.
Prompt vault: Stores and organizes reusable prompts for quick access during AI interactions.
Account isolation: Separates workspaces securely, particularly useful for managing multiple accounts.
Local backup: Ensures conversation histories remain accessible even if the underlying service experiences outages.

useCases.title: Research organization
useCases.description: Categorize dozens of complex AI research threads into distinct, color-coded project folders.

useCases.title: Code snippet management
useCases.description: Save and quickly retrieve valuable code generation sessions from various large language models.

useCases.title: Prompt engineering
useCases.description: Maintain a personal library of highly refined prompts to reuse consistently across different LLMs.

useCases.title: Workflow continuity
useCases.description: Protect conversational history from unexpected platform outages or data wipes by relying on local backups.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Researchers, developers, and power users who heavily rely on multiple AI chatbots for their daily workflows. It is ideal for anyone struggling to manage extensive lists of chat histories.
